title: Sovereign Debt Restructuring & Global Economic Architecture

sections.abstract: Liam Sterling asserts an exemplary academic record with a cumulative GPA of 3.95 and high honors in intermediate microeconomics, examining multilateral debt renegotiation frameworks.
sections.scientific_methodology: Empirical regression analysis of 64 sovereign restructuring episodes between 1990 and 2024 using Paris Club and IMF transparency disclosures.
sections.impact_and_dissemination: Policy briefing paper intended for the Yale Jackson School of Global Affairs and World Bank working papers series.
sections.work_packages: Phase 1: Macro-dataset assembly. Phase 2: Counterfactual simulation. Phase 3: Final thesis defense.
sections.budget: Request matches demonstrated financial need after standard family expected contribution.
